+"""Normalize configuration labels for matching."""
+
+
+def normalize_label(text: str) -> str:
+    """Lowercase a label and join whitespace-separated parts with underscores.
+
+    Preserve punctuation and reject empty or whitespace-only labels.
+    """
+    parts = text.split()
+    if not parts:
+        raise ValueError("Label must contain non-whitespace characters")
+    return "_".join(parts).lower()

+"""Tests for configuration label normalization."""
+
+import unittest
+
+from label_tools import normalize_label
+
+
+class NormalizeLabelTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_trims_and_collapses_spaces(self):
+        self.assertEqual(normalize_label("  Core Switch  "), "core_switch")
+
+    def test_collapses_actual_tabs(self):
+        self.assertEqual(normalize_label("WAN\t\tUplink"), "wan_uplink")
+
+    def test_preserves_hyphen(self):
+        self.assertEqual(normalize_label("Core-Switch"), "core-switch")
+
+    def test_rejects_empty(self):
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+            normalize_label("")
+
+    def test_rejects_spaces_only(self):
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+            normalize_label("   ")
+
+    def test_mixed_whitespace(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            normalize_label("\t Core \r\n\t Switch\v\f Uplink \n"),
+            "core_switch_uplink",
+        )
+
+    def test_unicode_whitespace(self):
+        self.assertEqual(normalize_label("\u2003Core\u00a0\u2003Switch\u2003"), "core_switch")
+
+    def test_rejects_other_whitespace_only(self):
+        for text in ("\t\r\n\v\f", "\u00a0\u2003"):
+            with self.subTest(text=text), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                normalize_label(text)
+
+    def test_preserves_punctuation_and_existing_underscores(self):
+        self.assertEqual(normalize_label(" A_B.C:/D-1!  (E) "), "a_b.c:/d-1!_(e)")

commands.description: Use only during the ChatGPT Work onboarding experience when the onboarding prompt or model explicitly invokes this skill for a user who is about to create an artifact such as a presentation, PDF, document, spreadsheet, or similar file. Infer the best artifact type, bias toward a presentation when the type is unclear, ask only high-leverage style or source questions, and create a polished compact first artifact with strict small-scope defaults. commands.name: $demos:onboarding-email

commands.name: $demos:onboarding-learn-writing-style

Explain that ChatGPT can learn from email, documents, past chats, uploads, and more; ask which writing style or source to start with; learn from a small verified sample; show a privacy-safe Writing Style Reference plus four or five relatable hypothetical examples; calibrate before saving; and never send or share anything. Use $answers-ask-user-input for source, connection, sample, and calibration choices. Do not use for ordinary writing, email, or document requests outside onboarding.

commands.name: $demos:onboarding-messaging
commands.description: Use only during the ChatGPT Work onboarding experience when the onboarding prompt or model explicitly invokes this skill to connect Slack, Microsoft Teams, or another messaging app and show a first useful messaging task. Reuse a verified connection when possible, ask for the provider only when needed, then demonstrate safe value such as a daily summary or reviewable reply drafts. Use $answers-ask-user-input for provider, workspace, task, or automation choices that cannot be inferred safely. Do not use for ordinary messaging requests outside onboarding.

commands.name: $demos:onboarding-parallel-research
commands.description: Use only during the ChatGPT Work onboarding experience when the onboarding prompt or model explicitly invokes this skill. Define exactly three mostly distinct, parallelizable subtopics and launch exactly three subagents concurrently with one owner per subtopic. Do not use for ordinary research requests outside onboarding.
